name: IL-15/IL-21 and interferon signaling in NK and NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 and type I/III interferon responses plus NK and NKT cell differentiation, proliferation and activation, which distinguishes the theme from the IL-10/IL-12/IL-23/IL-27 and IL-20/type III interferon production confusables.

qualifier: including oncogenic RAS and RAF mutants
name: RAS-RAF activation including oncogenic RAS and RAF mutants
rationale: All members concern RAS-to-RAF-to-MEK/ERK activation and its regulators (SOS, GAPs, SHOC2/MRAS) and disease mutants, whereas the confusables center on ERK inactivation and MAPK-level mutants.

name: tRNA maturation, transport and mitochondrial RNA turnover
rationale: Members cover tRNA end processing, intron splicing, modification, transport and tRF biogenesis plus mitochondrial RNA processing, import and catabolism, distinguishing them from pseudouridylation, aminoacylation and mitochondrial transcription/translation confusables.

name: Mucin-type O-GalNAc glycan synthesis and its disorders
rationale: All members concern GalNAc-initiated O-glycan biosynthesis and its GALNT/C1GALT1C1 defects, unlike the N-glycan, fucose and blood-group glycan confusables.

qualifier: PI3K arm and betaKlotho-dependent FGFR4 adaptor cascades
name: FGFR-PI3K signaling and betaKlotho-dependent FGFR4 adaptor cascades
rationale: Members are PI3K cascades of FGFR1-4 plus FGFR4 FRS/SHC signaling and betaKlotho ligand binding, separating the theme from confusables built on PLC cascades and FGFR1/2 adaptor signaling.

name: RHOQ-mediated GLUT4 vesicle targeting to plasma membrane
rationale: Members describe membrane targeting of GLUT4 driven by the RHOQ (TC10) GTPase cycle, rather than glucose import regulation, endosomal traffic or insulin secretion as in the confusables.

name: Inhibition of integrin- and Rac/Rho-driven cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: All members negatively regulate integrin, Rho/Rac signaling, lamellipodia and focal adhesions, distinguishing them from pro-migratory, CDC42 and angiogenesis- or epithelium-specific confusables.

name: tRNA and rRNA modification, aminoacylation and translational fidelity
rationale: Members span tRNA/rRNA processing and chemical modification, tRNA charging, diphthamide and translation termination fidelity, unlike the mitochondrial gene expression, protein modification and selenocysteine confusables.

qualifier: via SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, DCC and L1
name: Axon guidance and fasciculation via SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, DCC and L1
rationale: Members are midline and commissural guidance by SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin-DCC attraction and L1 with RAC1 control, whereas confusables emphasise netrin repulsion, semaphorin/CHL1/DSCAM or neuron-type-specific guidance.

qualifier: via K48 ubiquitination and TRiC/CCT chaperonin
name: Protein stability balance via K48 ubiquitination and TRiC/CCT chaperonin
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization versus proteasomal degradation and K48/auto-ubiquitination together with TRiC-assisted folding, unlike confusables centred on deubiquitination, ERAD, autophagy or actin/tubulin folding.

name: Monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, activation and extravasation
rationale: All members concern monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation and activation, distinct from the CCR2/CX3CR1 module and the broader inflammatory adhesion confusables.

name: Suppression of TLR/IL-1/TNF-NF-kappaB inflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members negatively regulate TLR, IL-1 and TNF signaling, NF-kappaB and proinflammatory cytokine production, whereas confusables involve IL-10/T-cell control, positive TLR regulation or inflammasomes.

name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation and its mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are CS/DS catabolism and the MPS I, II, VI and IX deficiencies, separating the theme from heparan/keratan sulfate (Sanfilippo, Morquio) and Sly confusables.

qualifier: via cAMP-coupled peptide and nutrient GPCRs
name: Gut-brain feeding control via cAMP-coupled peptide and nutrient GPCRs
rationale: Members span appetite, gastric secretion and motility, ghrelin and leptin, and glucagon, calcitonin/amylin, relaxin and nutrient-sensing GPCRs with cAMP signaling, whereas confusables centre on growth hormone, prolactin and glucocorticoid axes.

qualifier: regulation of pausing, elongation and termination
name: Regulation of RNA polymerase II pausing, elongation and termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II preinitiation, promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination, unlike confusables focused on core initiation/promoter escape steps and HIV transcription.

name: Endocytic recycling and early endosome cargo sorting
rationale: All members concern endosome organization, receptor recycling and early-endosome sorting, distinct from Golgi, secretory and ARF/Rab confusables.

name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling
rationale: Members concern endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and extravasation, vascular wound healing and remodeling, unlike VEGF/FGF angiogenesis, monocyte or smooth muscle migration confusables.

qualifier: and nuclear export, including histone mRNAs
name: mRNA 3'-end formation and nuclear export, including histone mRNAs
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, SLBP-dependent histone pre-mRNA processing and mature mRNA export, separating the theme from rRNA/tRNA export and cytoplasmic mRNA decay confusables.

name: B cell development, differentiation and proliferation
rationale: All members concern B cell development, differentiation and proliferation (with B-cell expression modules), not BCR signaling, germinal-centre or homeostasis themes of the confusables.

name: Retrograde intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER vesicle traffic
rationale: Members are COPI and COPI-independent retrograde, intra-Golgi and endosome-to-Golgi traffic plus Golgi retention, distinct from COPII ER export and Golgi organization confusables.

qualifier: in natriuresis, diuresis and heart rate
name: Cyclic nucleotide signaling in natriuresis, diuresis and heart rate
rationale: Members concern cGMP/cAMP responses, guanylyl cyclase signaling and neuropeptide catabolism linked to sodium excretion, urine volume, heart rate and neural blood pressure control, unlike renin-angiotensin and vasoconstriction confusables.

qualifier: ATF4/XBP1 branches and beta-cell apoptosis control
name: ER stress signaling via ATF4/XBP1 and beta-cell apoptosis control
rationale: Members are ER overload, ATF4 and XBP1 transcriptional programs and regulation of ER-stress and pancreatic beta-cell apoptosis, unlike ATF6/CREB3 and integrated or mitochondrial stress confusables.

name: Male germline chromatin remodeling and piRNA-directed transposon silencing
rationale: Members concern sperm chromatin compaction and protamine exchange, spermatogonial and Y-linked genes, and piRNA/DNA methylation heterochromatin silencing, unlike germ-cell specification, piRNA biogenesis or oocyte confusables.

qualifier: by RNA polymerase I with nucleolar chromatin control
name: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin control
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation, elongation and termination with NoRC, SIRT1, B-WICH and CSB chromatin regulation of rRNA expression, distinct from Pol III, rRNA processing and MYC-target confusables.

name: HIV-1 transcription elongation complex formation, Tat-dependent and independent
rationale: All three members describe assembly of the HIV-1 elongation complex with or without Tat, distinct from host Pol II elongation, HIV arrest/recovery and HIV initiation confusables.
